title: Prune repeated entry-point and component documentation
description:
README, MCP component documentation, CLI reference examples, and contributor entry points remain discoverable but no longer duplicate canonical release and deployment facts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: README.md presents the product and preferred quickstart, mcp-server/README.md describes component architecture and links to installation, and AGENTS.md/contrib/README.md remain contributor entry points without copying adopter workflows.
- [hard] REQ-02: Active-tree checks find one owner for installation commands, Docker/Compose commands, MCP package startup, artifact/support matrices, version/MSRV policy, and compatibility guarantees across README.md, INSTALL.md, docs/, mcp-server/README.md, AGENTS.md, and contrib/README.md.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every removed walkthrough leaves a valid, context-bearing link from its former audience entry point, and mechanical plus adversarial documentation review confirms no supported path became undiscoverable.
- [hard] REQ-04: Archived studies/session evidence and unrelated configurable cargo-audit gate examples remain unchanged.

## Notes

Blast radius: active entry-point and component documentation only; archived evidence, unrelated factual corrections, and configurable audit examples remain unchanged, and all merged documentation becomes source-freeze input.
